tagline: Global leader in sustainable packaging solutions for food and everyday necessities
hero_kpi_rationale: Reflects improvement in key operational performance despite comparable revenue stability, driven by a €76M cost savings program and disciplined cost management amid margin compression.

kpis.name: Comparable revenue
kpis.explanation: Sales value adjusted for year-over-year comparability.
kpis.description: Comparable revenue remained stable in 2024 versus 2023, with slight volume growth offset by price declines linked to lower raw material costs.

kpis.name: Adjusted operating profit
kpis.explanation: Operating result after adjustments for comparability.
kpis.description: Adjusted operating profit increased 6% in 2024 to €417M, driven by a €76M cost savings program and improved competitiveness.

kpis.name: Adjusted operating margin
kpis.explanation: Adjusted operating profit divided by revenue.
kpis.description: Adjusted operating margin improved to 10.1% in 2024, up 0.5 percentage points, driven by realized savings and cost management.
kpis.signal: Operating margin expansion despite flat revenue.

kpis.name: Free cash flow
kpis.explanation: Cash generated from operations after investments.
kpis.description: Free cash flow reached €216M in 2024, supported by higher profitability and reduced investments, despite prior-year working capital headwind.
kpis.signal: Strong cash flow from improved earnings and disciplined capex.

kpis.name: Net debt
kpis.explanation: Total financial debt less cash and equivalents.
kpis.description: Net debt declined to €1.2B in 2024 versus €1.3B in 2023, strengthening group financial health and enabling organic and inorganic investments.
kpis.signal: Net debt reduction and balance sheet reinforcement.

kpis.name: Net debt ratio
kpis.explanation: Measure of ability to repay debt from operating earnings.
kpis.description: Net debt to adjusted EBITDA ratio improved to 2.0x in 2024 from 2.2x in 2023, now at the lower bound of management's 2-3x target range.
kpis.signal: Ratio at lower bound of 2-3x target, indicating excellent financial health.

kpis.name: Competitiveness program savings
kpis.explanation: Amount of savings realized through the competitiveness improvement program.
kpis.description: The cost savings program delivered €76M in 2024 against a total target of €100M, with program completion anticipated below original cost estimates. Early-stage actions supported rapid achievement of planned savings.
kpis.signal: Accelerated savings program: €76M realized, €100M total target.

kpis.name: Progress toward renewable energy
kpis.explanation: Advancement in renewable energy usage as a key element of 2030 strategy.
kpis.description: The company advanced renewable energy usage in 2024 as a priority element of its 2030 sustainability strategy, with specific figures not available in the report.
kpis.signal: Progress in energy transition and sustainability.

risks.title: Large customer concentration
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned in Item 1A as a key risk. Strong language on 'could impair utilization capacity'. Risk stable but central to commercial strategy. 'Competition' category carries significant weight on customer relationships.

risks.title: Packaging regulatory evolution
risks.score_rationale: Central position in report, repeated with intensity: 'bans, regulations, uncertainty'. Upward trend in regulatory constraints. Critical category for the sector.

risks.title: Intellectual property protection
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in R&D context as 'essential'. Affirmed language, strategic position. Stable trend. Key technology category for differentiated innovation.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and IT infrastructure
risks.score_rationale: Identified as major operational risk with potential business continuity impact. Preventive but concerned tone. Upward trend in threats. Growing strategic category.

risks.title: Sustainable raw material availability
risks.score_rationale: Linked to supply and sustainability risks. Implicit mention through sustainable solutions investment. Upward trend. Central industrial category.

risks.title: Equipment technology obsolescence
risks.score_rationale: Explicit mention of risk becoming 'obsolete or inefficient'. Preventive but urgent tone. Stable trend. Critical technology category for competitiveness.

risks.title: Business interruption risks
risks.score_rationale: Mentions fire, flood, storm, or supply chain disruption risks. Concrete operational language. Stable trend. High-impact industrial category.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence in the 2024 annual report. Innovation strategy focuses on sustainable materials, operational efficiency, and reducing plastic dependence.
evidence: No reference to AI or related technologies (ML, advanced digital automation) in the text.
Cited innovations concern exclusively sustainable packaging materials and formulations.
Strategic priorities concentrate on cost reduction competitiveness, product innovation (paper, cardboard, fibers), and environmental sustainability.
